reference.title: Barbell KAS Glute Bridge (male)
reference.listing: Video (title and product number from the listing URL; the page itself could not be read from this environment, so the movement follows the exercise name and standard coaching)

breathing.pattern: Breathe in at the bottom of the short range, breathe out as you drive the hips up, hold briefly at the top.
breathing.cadence: About 1 s up, 0.8 s squeeze, 1.5 s down

prescription.load: Barbell load is user-chosen: you can use about as much as in a hip thrust; use a bar pad. Leave about 2-3 reps in reserve (RPE 7-8).
prescription.progression: Heavier bar, then a longer squeeze at the top.

cues.text: Upper back on the bench (higher on the pad than a hip thrust, just below the shoulder blades), bar with a pad on the hip crease, feet flat about hip width, knees above the ankles at the top.
Chin tucked, ribs down: the hips rise only from a little below level to level; the upper back stays still on the bench instead of rolling.
Hard glute squeeze at the top, pelvis tucked under.
Lower only a short way, keeping tension in the glutes; the bar never touches the floor.

mistakes.mistake: Turning it into a full hip thrust
mistakes.fix: Lower only until the hips are a little below the knees and the shoulders; keep the upper back still.

mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back at the top
mistakes.fix: Tuck the chin and pelvis; finish with the glutes.

mistakes.mistake: Feet too far out or too close
mistakes.fix: Set the feet so the shins are vertical at the top.

mistakes.mistake: Rocking the trunk on the bench
mistakes.fix: Keep the trunk fixed and move only at the hips.

kinematics.norm: Short range near full hip extension (Contreras 2015)
About 90 degrees at the top, knees above the ankles (common coaching)
Trunk stays fixed on the bench; the hips move (common coaching)
Bar across the hip crease, padded (common coaching)
Short controlled reps with a squeeze (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual, Barbell KAS Glute Bridge (male), video (movement reference only)

Contreras, Vigotsky, Schoenfeld, Beardsley & Cronin 2015, a comparison of gluteus maximus, biceps femoris and vastus lateralis EMG in the back squat and barbell hip thrust (J Appl Biomech 31(6):452-458)

cautions: Use a thick bar pad over the hips; roll the bar into place from the floor.
Use a bench that cannot slide.
Keep the chin tucked; do not let the neck arch over the bench.
Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
modify: Hip-bone discomfort: thicker pad, lighter bar.
Lower-back discomfort: shorten the range further and tuck the pelvis.
regressions: Barbell glute bridge on the floor.

muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Main hip extensor; the Kas bridge keeps the hips in the top part of the range, where hip-thrust gluteus maximus activity peaks (Contreras 2015).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Main hip extensor; the Kas bridge keeps the hips in the top part of the range, where hip-thrust gluteus maximus activity peaks (Contreras 2015).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Assist hip extension; less active with the knees bent about 90 degrees at the top.
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Assist hip extension; less active with the knees bent about 90 degrees at the top.
muscleNotes.quads_r: Hold the knee angle so the hips, not the knees, do the work.
muscleNotes.quads_l: Hold the knee angle so the hips, not the knees, do the work.
muscleNotes.adductors_r: Help extend the hips and keep the knees from flaring.
muscleNotes.adductors_l: Help extend the hips and keep the knees from flaring.
muscleNotes.glute_med_r: Keeps the pelvis level and the knees over the feet.
muscleNotes.glute_med_l: Keeps the pelvis level and the knees over the feet.
muscleNotes.core: Holds the ribs down so the lower back does not arch at the top.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Keep the spine neutral; the movement should come from the hips, not the lower back.
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Keep the spine neutral; the movement should come from the hips, not the lower back.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_r: Hold the bar in place on the hips.
muscleNotes.forearm_flexors_l: Hold the bar in place on the hips.
muscleNotes.lats_r: Help pin the bar to the hips with straight arms.
muscleNotes.lats_l: Help pin the bar to the hips with straight arms.
muscleNotes.triceps_r: Press down on the bar to steady it.
muscleNotes.triceps_l: Press down on the bar to steady it.
